_comment: Expansion 3 part E.2: spells outside battle - light, the body on the move, travel (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Numbers from the 2024 Player's Handbook, checked on the page images (build/e2_facts.json while building). Lasting buffs are read outside a fight by the sheet (rules/character.py) and the world (game/), inside one by the battle (rules/engine/marks.py lists the keys); travel by magic is game/waymagic.py.

light.name: Light
light.text: Something you carry sheds bright light 20 feet round and dim light 20 more, for an hour: no torch is needed underground or in the dark.

dancing_lights.name: Dancing Lights
dancing_lights.text: Four torch-sized lights hover over a spot you choose, lighting it dimly for a minute: foes hiding in the dark there can be seen.

continual_flame.name: Continual Flame

material.text: ruby dust worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

continual_flame.text: A flame that gives no heat and never goes out springs from a torch: it lights the way like a torch for ever.

daylight.name: Daylight
daylight.text: Sunlight 60 feet round something you carry, for an hour, and dim light 60 more. It ends magical darkness of level 3 or lower that it touches.

darkvision.name: Darkvision
darkvision.text: A willing creature you touch sees in the dark 150 feet for 8 hours.

see_invisibility.name: See Invisibility
see_invisibility.text: For an hour you see invisible creatures and things as if they were not.

jump.name: Jump
jump.text: For a minute a willing creature can leap 30 feet, over water, chasms and fire (one more creature for each slot level above 1).

longstrider.name: Longstrider
longstrider.text: A creature's speed rises by 10 feet for an hour: in a fight, and on the road it makes up for a heavy load or a lame leg (one more creature for each slot level above 1).

feather_fall.name: Feather Fall
feather_fall.text: A reaction when someone falls within 60 feet: they drift down and land unharmed. Cast by itself, in a fight or over a dungeon's pit.

spider_climb.name: Spider Climb
spider_climb.text: For an hour a willing creature climbs walls and over barrels and fences as fast as it walks, hands free.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.text: A creature that fails a Constitution save rises 20 feet and hangs there for up to 10 minutes, out of reach of the ground, then floats gently down.

water_breathing.name: Water Breathing
water_breathing.text: Up to ten friends breathe under water for a day: they can walk across the bottom of a lake, slowly and soaked, where there is no way round.

water_walk.name: Water Walk
water_walk.text: For an hour up to ten friends walk on water as on solid ground: rivers without wading, lakes and the sea's edge on foot, deep water in a fight.

gaseous_form.name: Gaseous Form
gaseous_form.text: A willing creature becomes drifting mist: it flies 10 feet, takes half from blades and blows, and cannot attack or cast. A way out of a losing fight.

meld_into_stone.name: Meld into Stone
meld_into_stone.text: You step into a rock for up to 8 hours: alone, you can rest there unseen however many hunt for you.

feign_death.name: Feign Death
feign_death.text: A willing friend falls as if dead for an hour: foes leave the body alone, and if the fight is lost they go away thinking it over.

alter_self.name: Alter Self
alter_self.text: For an hour you change your own body: on the road a face nobody knows (a disguise no watchman sees through), in a fight gills and webbed hands.

enhance_ability.name: Enhance Ability
enhance_ability.text: For an hour a creature has Advantage on checks with its best ability: a strong arm, quick hands, a sharp mind or a silver tongue.

pass_without_trace.name: Pass without Trace
pass_without_trace.text: For an hour you and your friends near you move with +10 to Stealth and leave no tracks: creeping, slipping away, hiding.

phantom_steed.name: Phantom Steed
phantom_steed.text: A quasi-real horse, saddled and bridled, carries one rider 13 miles an hour for an hour. One for each rider makes the whole party quick.

tensers_floating_disk.name: Tenser's Floating Disk
tensers_floating_disk.text: A floating disk of force follows you for an hour and carries up to 500 pounds of your load.

unseen_servant.name: Unseen Servant
unseen_servant.text: An invisible servant fetches, carries and works for an hour: lighting the fire, cooking, pitching the tent and the like take half the time.

wind_walk.name: Wind Walk
wind_walk.text: You and up to ten friends become clouds for 8 hours and fly ten times a walker's pace, over water and mountains, met by nothing on the ground.

transport_via_plants.name: Transport via Plants
transport_via_plants.text: From a great tree here, step into another you have seen anywhere in the world: woods beside any town you have been to.

tree_stride.name: Tree Stride

again.name: Tree Stride: another tree
again.text: While the spell holds, once a turn: into a tree beside you and out of another on the field.

tree_stride.text: For a minute, once a turn, step into a tree beside you and out of another anywhere on the field.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.text: You and up to eight friends to a place you know. The better you know it, the surer the arrival: off target, somewhere like it, or a mishap that hurts.

teleportation_circle.name: Teleportation Circle

material.text: rare inks worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

teleportation_circle.text: A circle of sigils opens onto a city's permanent circle: every city you have visited, its sigils learned. Everyone steps through.

word_of_recall.name: Word of Recall
word_of_recall.text: Cast in a town with a temple, it makes that temple your sanctuary; cast anywhere after, it takes you and five friends back to it at once.

arcane_gate.name: Arcane Gate
arcane_gate.text: Under the ground, two glowing rings join where you stand and the stairs up or down within 500 feet: the party steps through.

find_the_path.name: Find the Path

material.text: a set of divination tools (such as cards or runes) worth 100+ GP

find_the_path.text: For a day you know the most direct way: nobody in the party loses their bearings, and under the ground the way to the stairs is shown.

plane_shift.name: Plane Shift

material.text: a forked, metal rod worth 250+ GP and attuned to a plane of existence

plane_shift.text: Hand in hand, you and eight friends step out of the world and back in: at a city's circle you know, or somewhere near any other place you name.

etherealness.name: Etherealness
etherealness.text: For up to 8 hours you walk the grey border of the world: nobody on the road sees you, walls and doors do not stop you, traps do not spring (three more for each slot above 7).

astral_projection.name: Astral Projection
astral_projection.text: An hour's rite, a jacinth and a silver bar of 100 GP for each of you: your spirits cross the Astral and draw your bodies after them to any place you know.

gate.name: Gate
gate.text: A portal opens onto any place you know, and the party steps through. (The other planes it was made for are not yet in the world.)
